decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/DP3906BE (holder Equinix (UK) Limited, premises '6/7/8/9, LD8', Harbour Exchange Square, London E14 9GE): latitude 51.498163, longitude -0.014911 (grid reference TQ3789079560), copied without transformation, as the campus locator of Equinix LD8. It is the regulator's single site point for the permitted combustion installation that serves the two converted Harbour Exchange buildings 6/7 and 8/9, not a building outline or surveyed position.

selected_properties.address: 6/7/8/9, LD8, LD8, Harbour Exchange Square, London, E14 9GE

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing (537890, 179560) gives 51.4981688, -0.0149180, 0.81 m from the published point.

consistency_checks.permit_decision_document: The decision document published at the register's documentURL (local_data/country-research-uk-ops-p10/govuk-ld8-dp3906be-a001-decision-document.pdf, sha256 6e4c22743caf9fe189739cc6faae0b6849194195807e8973b1dfd3cfb1891cfd; GOV.UK publication of 27 October 2023) grants the permit 'for LD8 operated by Equinix (UK) Limited', places the site 'at National Grid Reference TQ 37882 79559' and says the 6/7 and 8/9 Harbour Exchange (HEX) buildings were converted to data centres in about 1999 and acquired by the applicant in 2016; 13 of the 17 standby generators are inside buildings 6/7 and 8/9 and 4 are outside, to their south. pyproj 3.7.1 converts TQ 37882 79559 to 51.4981618, -0.0150336, 8.5 m from the register point.
consistency_checks.operator_address: Equinix's LD8 page (Internet Archive raw copy of 3 October 2026, local_data/country-research-uk-ops-p10/ia-eqx-ld8-20261003181051.html) gives the address '6/7/8/9 Harbour Exchange Square, Limeharbour, E14 9GE London', the same premises and postcode as the register.
consistency_checks.nearby_records: Atlas records within 2 km: Telehouse London Docklands Campus (three projects at one point, 1.76 km north-east). Other Environment Agency data-centre installations within 2 km, none in the Atlas: Digital London Limited, Cloud House, 1 Muirfield Crescent E14 9SZ (EPR/HB3099YF, 0.30 km); SOF-11 Docklands DC UK Bidco LCY10, Greenwich View Place E14 9NN (EPR/QP3108ST, 0.37 km); Cyxtera LHR2, 7 Greenwich View Place (EPR/UP3528SQ, 0.47 km; Keppel GV7 is under the europe13 closure-conflict hold); Colt Data Centre, Poplar Business Park E14 9XX (EPR/VB3295YY, 1.08 km); Global Switch, East India Dock House E14 9YY (EPR/BP3530YR, 1.59 km; held). Each has a different holder, address and permit from LD8.
consistency_checks.not_used: No commercial map, map widget, map-link coordinate, geocoder, postcode centroid, PeeringDB, OpenStreetMap, town centre or estate centroid is used. The coordinate constants in the map-widget script of Equinix's archived pages were not read for the locator.

scope_note: The point locates Equinix's LD8 installation (buildings 6/7 and 8/9 Harbour Exchange Square with their external generator area) as a whole, not either building.
